task: All local eligible MIDI, chart-constrained coarse chord estimation and shared causal following
instruments: all available pitched bass/horn MIDI; percussion excluded; piano MIDI absent

chord_schemes.seventh: root+triad and seventh family; ignore 6/9/11/13 additions, alterations and inversions

chord_task: Choose among unique reduced labels occurring in this known chart, not unconstrained chord recognition
chord_accuracy: top1 correct reduced label / all non-N.C. labeled frames; unavailable evidence counts incorrect
tie_rules: Pardo uses root-weight tie rule, then vocabulary order; others vocabulary order. Fractional1/k accuracy also reported.
balanced_accuracy: mean recall over each distinct reference label within a performance, standard class-balanced accuracy
root_accuracy: correct root regardless of quality; silence counts incorrect
majority_baseline: constant chord with largest total duration in untimed score beats; uses no performed timestamps
no_chord: excluded from chord accuracy; neutral harmonic likelihood at N.C. plan positions; bar following still evaluated

method_scope.cosine_onsets: binary chord-tone cosine on trailing onset counts
method_scope.cosine_duration: binary chord-tone cosine on trailing elapsed note durations
method_scope.pardo: published P-(M+N), minimal-segment counts and root tie rule; causal windows/reduced chart vocabulary are adaptations
method_scope.yamaha_active: published log likelihood x^TT; binary88-key roll/templates and no melody are reconstruction choices
method_scope.empirical_profile: leave-one-composition-out root-relative pitch-class log likelihood; symmetric0.5 pseudocount per class; other preferred takes only

cap4s: pooled-only sensitivity; common causal max4-second contribution per note, no label-based cleaning
position_filter: shared position-tempo grid Bayesian baseline, NOT complete Yamaha/Pardo followers
position_initialization: known first musical position and synchronized start time; approximate catalog BPM
position_plan: unfolded chord/bar order and musical durations from bar/fraction coordinates; no timed reference after initialization
position_score_scaling: per-row z-score+softmax, fixedunittemperature, same for all methods; uncalibrated compatibility potentials
position_stress: triad preferred only: initial BPM multiplied0.9 or1.1, same raw MIDI; controlled initialization error

position_metrics.bar_accuracy: fraction of200ms frames at correct unfolded plan bar; MIDI adaptation of measure-number alignment accuracy
position_metrics.within2beat_accuracy: fraction within2 score beats; MIDI-frame adaptation of alignment-rate/tolerance evaluation
position_metrics.mean_median_abs: all-frame absolute error, no exclusion of errors>2 beats; differs from Matchmaker conditional summaries
position_metrics.reference_beats: interpolated within annotated bars; not independently annotated beat onsets

evaluation_status: exploratory all-song sweep; no held-out best-setting claim; learned profiles exclude same composition
